counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Wuping Circuit (Liu Yan, Wang Kui, Zhou Xingfeng)

problems: No Cliopatria row exists for any of the 19 states; every dossier has cliopatria_names [] and new keyframes only. The 19 validate with 0 errors, 0 warnings and --resolve clean.

Eight WebFetch URLs failed with URL_NOT_FOUND (listed under pages_failed); four of them (Lulong Circuit, Chengde Circuit, Dingnan Circuit, Wuping Circuit) are circuits with no English article found, so wikipedia is null for lulong-circuit, dingnan-circuit, qingyuan-circuit, jinghai-circuit and zhao-five-dynasties-period (the last uses the Wang Rong page).

Pages disagree: Liangzhou taken by Zhang Yichao 863 versus 861; Chen Hongjin's surrender 977 (text) versus 978 (infobox); Khuc Thua My captured 923 versus 930; Shi Siming's accession 10 April versus 9 May 759; Li Jiqian's death 6 January versus 26 January 1004; Xiliangfu ends 1016 (its page) versus 1032 (Western Xia, Timeline of the Tanguts). The dossier takes the most specific sentence and keeps the other in the note.

The four Tang protectorate dossiers and guiyi-circuit repeat land that the Tang dossier already carries as direct gains, losses and vassal events; a reviewer must pick the owner in the renderer (see the cross-dossier section of the notes file).
Several states rest on one page (li-gui-s-liang, liu-heita-s-handong, fu-gongshi-s-song, xu-yuanlang-s-lu) or on a stub (beiting-protectorate); the Hebei circuits before 883 are one keyframe each.

Shared mount: the notes file and this report were written once and read back; two existing files of this batch (yan-an-lushan, weibo-circuit) were edited after first writing, with the validator re-run each time.
